title: Performance and scale
current_gap: Single-machine 3x speed or two-vehicle validation does not prove ten-vehicle, arbitrary-hardware or distributed real-time performance.

atoms.name: target_vehicle_count
atoms.required: Declared target vehicle count accepted on the joint scene; two-vehicle evidence is a subset

atoms.name: step_rate_frequency
atoms.required: Step rate/speedup met with explicit RateUnmet on breach; 0.5/1.0 rate validation is a bounded profile

atoms.name: throughput_load
atoms.required: CPU/GPU load and throughput budget per configuration; the tracefs collector is diagnostics, not a budget proof

atoms.name: record_capacity
atoms.required: Recording capacity at target scale under the OPS-11 record contract

atoms.name: time_deviation_recovery_window
atoms.required: Quantified time-deviation bounds and recovery windows at scale; barrier/suspend semantics alone are unquantified

atoms.name: distributed_realtime
atoms.required: Multi-host distributed real-time validation with per-host identity; nothing current proves it

scope_rule: a bounded profile proves only its own configuration; hardware, vehicle count and speedup do not extrapolate

followups.blocked_by: Declared target vehicle count and hardware identity

files: runtime source reserved after distribution decision

preserved.collector: read-only diagnostics; not a budget proof
